title: Wednesday Quick Tip
subtitle: Where you correct
hook: Where do you correct a player in front of the team?
statement: Kids hear corrections better without an audience.
q1: Do you pull a player aside to correct them —
q2: or correct in the moment so everyone learns?
q3: How does that player feel with everyone watching?
t1: Every coach is different. But corrections land
t2: when a player does not feel on display.
cta: Coaches — where do you correct players?
ctaLines: Aside, quietly. In the moment. Depends on the kid.
ctaPrompt: Share your coaching habit below. There are no wrong answers.
caption:
Where do you correct a player in front of the team?
You see a mistake mid-drill. The whole team is watching.
Kids hear corrections better without an audience.
Correct in private or in the moment. Every team is different.
Where do you correct players? Share your habit in the comments.
